name: – Tomas Tobé – After § 80 – Am 6
title: REPORT on the findings and recommendations of the Special Committee on the European Democracy Shield
part_text: 80a. Recognises the particular threat of interference posed by the Muslim Brotherhood, notably through the infiltration and manipulation of European civil society via third-party organisations; is concerned, in this regard, about the Commission’s funding of the European Network Against Racism (ENAR), despite its links to the Muslim Brotherhood (as demonstrated by the French Ministry of the Interior in 2025); is also concerned about the activities of other organisations such as the Council of European Muslims (CEM), the Forum of European Muslim Youth and Student Organisations, (FEMYSO) and the Collectif Contre l’Islamophobie en Europe (CCIE), which form a complex network propagating the ideology of the Muslim Brotherhood and threatening European societies;
